So we cleared out for the house."}, {"id": "043-038-0043", "tag": "source_caption", "text": "The Breakfast-Horn", "sha256": "7c42d8e21290e5f8927fe63bb224b1df06b1f56d63bdda4e3f649a037b9bda60", "source_location": "illustration-index/#c35-305", "image_id": "c35-305"}, {"id": "043-038-0044", "tag": "p", "text": "Along during the morning I borrowed a sheet and a white shirt off of the clothes-line; and I found an old sack and put them in it, and we went down and got the fox-fire, and put that in too. I called it borrowing, because that was what pap always called it; but Tom said it warn’t borrowing, it was stealing. He said we was representing prisoners; and prisoners don’t care how they get a thing so they get it, and nobody don’t blame them for it, either. It ain’t no crime in a prisoner to steal the thing he needs to get away with, Tom said; it’s his right; and so, as long as we was representing a prisoner, we had a perfect right to steal anything on this place we had the least use for to get ourselves out of prison with. He said if we warn’t prisoners it would be a very different thing, and nobody but a mean, ornery person would steal when he warn’t a prisoner. So we allowed we would steal everything there was that come handy. And yet he made a mighty fuss, one day, after that, when I stole a watermelon out of the nigger-patch and eat it; and he made me go and give the niggers a dime without telling them what it was for. Tom said that what he meant was, we could steal anything we needed. Well, I says, I needed the watermelon. But he said I didn’t need it to get out of prison with; there’s where the difference was. He said if I’d a wanted it to hide a knife in, and smuggle it to Jim to kill the seneskal with, it would a been all right. So I let it go at that, though I couldn’t see no advantage in my representing a prisoner if I got to set down and chaw over a lot of gold-leaf distinctions like that every time I see a chance to hog a watermelon.", "sha256": "6c3eb5c0c8b996fb031349c80d07eaae942845d99e7c37919e7d2b7fe68186fb", "source_location": "div.chapter[40]/*[44]", "source_html": "Along during the morning I borrowed a sheet and a white shirt off of the clothes-line; and I found an old sack and put them in it, and we went down and got the fox-fire, and put that in too. He said if we warn’t prisoners it would be a very different thing, and nobody but a mean, ornery person would steal when he warn’t a prisoner. So we allowed we would steal everything there was that come handy. And yet he made a mighty fuss, one day, after that, when I stole a watermelon out of the nigger-patch and eat it; and he made me go and give the niggers a dime without telling them what it was for. So I let it go at that, though I couldn’t see no advantage in my representing a prisoner if I got to set down and chaw over a lot of gold-leaf distinctions like that every time I see a chance to hog a watermelon."}, {"id": "043-038-0045", "tag": "p", "text": "Well, as I was saying, we waited that morning till everybody was settled down to business, and nobody in sight around the yard; then Tom he carried the sack into the lean-to whilst I stood off a piece to keep watch. By-and-by he come out, and we went and set down on the woodpile to talk. He says:", "sha256": "6d2ba649660183ad9f73b566b555a1b4c2a1e429bee20bddfbf19f800b9664bd", "source_location": "div.chapter[40]/*[45]", "source_html": "Well, as I was saying, we waited that morning till everybody was settled down to business, and nobody in sight around the yard; then Tom he carried the sack into the lean-to whilst I stood off a piece to keep watch. By-and-by he come out, and we went and set down on the woodpile to talk. He says:"}, {"id": "043-038-0046", "tag": "p", "text": "“Everything’s all right now except tools; and that’s easy fixed.”", "sha256": "e49265f7c2de681fb77bfaca172f24eab867bf39eff154ddf44952a1f0b390f9", "source_location": "div.chapter[40]/*[46]", "source_html": "“Everything’s all right now except tools; and that’s easy fixed.”"}, {"id": "043-038-0047", "tag": "p", "text": "“Tools?” I says.", "sha256": "c3cd9ff44f5b13f2862216ca227f5262ff2bc11c352aa657a06012655970aac3", "source_location": "div.chapter[40]/*[47]", "source_html": "“Tools?” I says."}, {"id": "043-038-0048", "tag": "p", "text": "“Yes.”", "sha256": "838a04296799794f4e1a85c40540fd52027a3aa3d6a1cd735f69b489839212cf", "source_location": "div.chapter[40]/*[48]", "source_html": "“Yes.”"}, {"id": "043-038-0049", "tag": "p", "text": "“Tools for what?”", "sha256": "29edd0817273759538c62456d9e0d35d4e362c8249f4d2493fe6c2a9cf49db36", "source_location": "div.chapter[40]/*[49]", "source_html": "“Tools for what?”"}, {"id": "043-038-0050", "tag": "p", "text": "“Why, to dig with. We ain’t a-going to gnaw him out, are we?”", "sha256": "4a6d4512fe896387165821365c52b9e498bf77894ee9690c881dc0ac63752233", "source_location": "div.chapter[40]/*[50]", "source_html": "“Why, to dig with. We ain’t a-going to gnaw him out, are we?”"}, {"id": "043-038-0051", "tag": "p", "text": "“Ain’t them old crippled picks and things in there good enough to dig a nigger out with?” I says.", "sha256": "bcb6f0f21804794e8f68ed934bff2c7f1fba44d2a29902ed0c4ae358c5088eeb", "source_location": "div.chapter[40]/*[51]", "source_html": "“Ain’t them old crippled picks and things in there good enough to dig a nigger out with?” I says."}, {"id": "043-038-0052", "tag": "p", "text": "He turns on me, looking pitying enough to make a body cry, and says:", "sha256": "3e3cc5a0d0092288f8ec6fdb91325b18bba2f06e6eb28f29e6ae34efab038278", "source_location": "div.chapter[40]/*[52]", "source_html": "He turns on me, looking pitying enough to make a body cry, and says:"}, {"id": "043-038-0053", "tag": "p", "text": "“Huck Finn, did you ever hear of a prisoner having picks and shovels, and all the modern conveniences in his wardrobe to dig himself out with? Now I want to ask you—if you got any reasonableness in you at all—what kind of a show would that give him to be a hero? Why, they might as well lend him the key and done with it. Picks and shovels—why, they wouldn’t furnish ’em to a king.”", "sha256": "2cad1e20cf3e8886ad47116a8c4ba9ba32d7d6a01350d692fb3d58ea836dca1d", "source_location": "div.chapter[40]/*[53]", "source_html": "“Huck Finn, did you ever hear of a prisoner having picks and shovels, and all the modern conveniences in his wardrobe to dig himself out with? Now I want to ask you—if you got any reasonableness in you at all—what kind of a show would that give him to be a hero? Why, they might as well lend him the key and done with it. Picks and shovels—why, they wouldn’t furnish ’em to a king.”"}, {"id": "043-038-0054", "tag": "p", "text": "“Well, then,” I says, “if we don’t want the picks and shovels, what do we want?”", "sha256": "cc7af51ac4651cd48695d7fe58b27c9fd6af08fa5f0df68735e01617227e6ac4", "source_location": "div.chapter[40]/*[54]", "source_html": "“Well, then,” I says, “if we don’t want the picks and shovels, what do we want?”"}, {"id": "043-038-0055", "tag": "p", "text": "“A couple of case-knives.”", "sha256": "bc8e0b8f01bafefcae46d1890ba5069afbae7e323c8a1086af9b8bc601d0acad", "source_location": "div.chapter[40]/*[55]", "source_html": "“A couple of case-knives.”"}, {"id": "043-038-0056", "tag": "p", "text": "“To dig the foundations out from under that cabin with?”", "sha256": "2da0f3233f5b672a213ac7c3b84569ab47edcaafbd6fe9aeef7c7eb32696d30c", "source_location": "div.chapter[40]/*[56]", "source_html": "“To dig the foundations out from under that cabin with?”"}, {"id": "043-038-0057", "tag": "p", "text": "“Yes.”", "sha256": "838a04296799794f4e1a85c40540fd52027a3aa3d6a1cd735f69b489839212cf", "source_location": "div.chapter[40]/*[57]", "source_html": "“Yes.”"}, {"id": "043-038-0058", "tag": "p", "text": "“Confound it, it’s foolish, Tom.”", "sha256": "d9c2af1433559febd5b79c955d77f674510db2b200d62868ed385f26040f168a", "source_location": "div.chapter[40]/*[58]", "source_html": "“Confound it, it’s foolish, Tom.”"}, {"id": "043-038-0059", "tag": "p", "text": "“It don’t make no difference how foolish it is, it’s the right way—and it’s the regular way. And there ain’t no other way, that ever I heard of, and I’ve read all the books that gives any information about these things. They always dig out with a case-knife—and not through dirt, mind you; generly it’s through solid rock. And it takes them weeks and weeks and weeks, and for ever and ever. Why, look at one of them prisoners in the bottom dungeon of the Castle Deef, in the harbor of Marseilles, that dug himself out that way; how long was he at it, you reckon?”", "sha256": "853bc7e6aa62c2e5da75e72ec66989e13a0c666bcad12ec67d53548d7e3a2d17", "source_location": "div.chapter[40]/*[59]", "source_html": "“It don’t make no difference how foolish it is, it’s the right way—and it’s the regular way. And there ain’t no other way, that ever I heard of, and I’ve read all the books that gives any information about these things. They always dig out with a case-knife—and not through dirt, mind you; generly it’s through solid rock. And it takes them weeks and weeks and weeks, and for ever and ever. Why, look at one of them prisoners in the bottom dungeon of the Castle Deef, in the harbor of Marseilles, that dug himself out that way; how long was he at it, you reckon?”"}], "final_rows": [{"source_id": "043-038-0040", "target": "— Но это же чьи-то тарелки, разве нет?", "source_sha256": "55c328a3b25cbbef05721658c372f8d673a261225646c0416afcb5dd6eac2c17", "target_id": "ru-043-038-0040", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "9dfa8dbe0be6d47e3a924717fd967870055963ca554c57c2515c03874fa741b6"}, {"source_id": "043-038-0041", "target": "— Ну а если и так? Какое дело узнику, чьи…", "source_sha256": "c9dec4f43c6c3399420bf66eb8c8482f1e1b73cf812e65fde1752388073907b1", "target_id": "ru-043-038-0041", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "5d514a5f0e78c4f1e5c701de8b1da4bc7f424f5a55a8a705d0d1ab41fbf32887"}, {"source_id": "043-038-0042", "target": "Он осёкся, потому что мы услышали, как трубят к завтраку. Мы и пошли к дому.", "source_sha256": "a767757ecbe15510cf7e790c493d0f1427c8130a2859ce8169bae2428ebf6cff", "target_id": "ru-043-038-0042", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "29f6d836a6e351f448a6d017bb594659179f2b8203a32e8dd2f88322b9d58ebc"}, {"source_id": "043-038-0043", "target": "Рожок к завтраку", "source_sha256": "7c42d8e21290e5f8927fe63bb224b1df06b1f56d63bdda4e3f649a037b9bda60", "target_id": "ru-043-038-0043", "tag": "source_caption", "target_sha256": "0cf5bf1950d17bd46792b102fb947d303f3aff3b3d55451f54a8e7f49e190cdb"}, {"source_id": "043-038-0044", "target": "Ближе к утру я позаимствовал с бельевой верёвки простыню и белую рубашку; потом нашёл старый мешок, сунул их туда, и мы пошли, взяли гнилушек, которые светятся, и их тоже положили. Я называл это «позаимствовал», потому что так всегда называл папаша; а Том сказал, что это не заимствование, а воровство. Он сказал, что мы изображаем узников, а узникам всё равно, как они что-нибудь добудут, лишь бы добыли, и никто их за это не осуждает. Для узника не преступление украсть то, что нужно для побега, сказал Том; это его право; и раз уж мы изображаем узника, то имеем полное право украсть здесь всё, что нам хоть чуточку пригодится, чтобы выбраться из тюрьмы. Он сказал, что будь мы не узниками, это было бы совсем другое дело, и красть, не будучи узником, станет только подлый, дрянной человек. Так что мы решили красть всё, что подвернётся под руку. А однако потом, в один из дней, он поднял страшный шум, когда я стащил арбуз с негритянской бахчи и съел его; и заставил меня пойти и дать неграм десять центов, не говоря, за что. Том сказал, что имел в виду другое: красть можно всё, что нам нужно. Ну, говорю, мне арбуз был нужен. А он говорит, что арбуз был мне не нужен, чтобы выбраться из тюрьмы; вот в чём разница. Он сказал, что если бы я хотел спрятать в нём нож и тайком передать Джиму, чтобы тот убил сенешаля, тогда было бы всё в порядке. Ну, я на этом и согласился, хотя никакой пользы в том, что я изображаю узника, не видел, если каждый раз, как подвернётся случай слопать арбуз, мне придётся садиться и пережёвывать кучу таких позолоченных тонкостей.", "source_sha256": "6c3eb5c0c8b996fb031349c80d07eaae942845d99e7c37919e7d2b7fe68186fb", "target_id": "ru-043-038-0044", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "1f5d1e6d7bd328c76e5577aa64c9100723376f01251ff8aa271e291c96b51d34"}, {"source_id": "043-038-0045", "target": "Так вот, как я говорил, в то утро мы выждали, пока все сядут за свои дела и во дворе никого не будет видно; тогда Том отнёс мешок в пристройку, а я отошёл подальше и стоял на страже. Скоро он вышел, и мы пошли и сели на поленницу поговорить. Он говорит:", "source_sha256": "6d2ba649660183ad9f73b566b555a1b4c2a1e429bee20bddfbf19f800b9664bd", "target_id": "ru-043-038-0045", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "e4816b0cce244dd53ca380603c62400c2135b49bf833eb5c9ea4aee24fac4b00"}, {"source_id": "043-038-0046", "target": "— Теперь всё в порядке, кроме инструментов; а это легко уладить.", "source_sha256": "e49265f7c2de681fb77bfaca172f24eab867bf39eff154ddf44952a1f0b390f9", "target_id": "ru-043-038-0046", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "b0c798c220009f1fc0c4312b4acf523b99ba7edae1e8bab05245bada273b7198"}, {"source_id": "043-038-0047", "target": "— Инструментов? — говорю я.", "source_sha256": "c3cd9ff44f5b13f2862216ca227f5262ff2bc11c352aa657a06012655970aac3", "target_id": "ru-043-038-0047", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "7da22e0acbeecde2dfa801c9428ed19745d1587d68ba67fa08f51f820fe808b9"}, {"source_id": "043-038-0048", "target": "— Да.", "source_sha256": "838a04296799794f4e1a85c40540fd52027a3aa3d6a1cd735f69b489839212cf", "target_id": "ru-043-038-0048", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "b38bdfda461dc2130aa710240e46c220d11d45c3bc5fe7d22b9278a9a8f4972c"}, {"source_id": "043-038-0049", "target": "— Инструментов для чего?", "source_sha256": "29edd0817273759538c62456d9e0d35d4e362c8249f4d2493fe6c2a9cf49db36", "target_id": "ru-043-038-0049", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "58f619b8aa0c1029dd3175baebb087a58f2484bc85acd289f8ea4cdcf6c30ea8"}, {"source_id": "043-038-0050", "target": "— Ну как для чего, копать. Вот я хочу тебя спросить — если в тебе есть хоть капля здравого смысла, — какой шанс стать героем это ему даст? Да лучше уж сразу одолжили бы ему ключ, и дело с концом.
